notes.title: RELEASE: Lisa the temptress and Tracy's infidelity expansion
notes.notes:
We’re back with a searing two-part expansion that cranks up the tension in LWT: American Sunset. This isn’t just a continuation—it’s a descent into dangerous passions, forbidden choices, and moments that will test every boundary. Seduction collides with betrayal, and voyeuristic thrills spiral into something far more perilous. Get ready: every decision cuts deeper, and every encounter risks everything.


Lisa Unleashed[p align="start"]The first chapter wastes no time turning up the heat. Lisa, no longer hiding behind innocence, unleashes her full seductive power. After a chaotic night of partying, Justin finds himself in her orbit—and she’s in no mood to play coy. What follows is a whirlwind of temptation and recklessness: sneaking under the sheets while Tracy lies asleep, ambushing Justin at work with a provocative toy-fueled fantasy, and even dragging him into a brazen sugar daddy roleplay. Lisa becomes unstoppable—a force of raw desire, dangerous and intoxicating in equal measure. This is Lisa unchained.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/348d03ea56fd6bfba3c48fc02d7678dbaf8c70b3.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/1d0776d1864f6beedbd047e8efb3c91a6eef3a48.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/3c4c0806533bbeea536dcd03ac59b5823311bb6d.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/680d847f20c437205caf1350449f902d64758121.jpg"]
Tracy’s Turn[p align="start"]But every flame leaves a burn. Tracy begins to sense the truth, and once the affair is uncovered, her response is anything but passive. Fueled by fury and desire, she sets out on her own path of infidelity. It begins with a shocking nightclub bathroom tryst with Daniel, but it doesn’t stop there. Hotel rooms, office encounters—each meeting grows more intense, more deliberate, transforming Justin into a helpless voyeur of his own downfall. And in the devastating finale, he’s left stranded outside a hotel door, forced to listen as Tracy and Daniel cross one final, forbidden line… while a bored maid looks on, indifferent to his unraveling.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/a0bb537d03269859f3b9a12114075edd315bce1e.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/0cf9c59c79ce2d3176c3847fff6a844a5eb62de7.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/d73a5d40f4f719cc41e9e40e5ae4d089c6d7b502.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/6be23654e88bbc0b27113e62068e9459a615b632.gif"]
The Expansion at a Glance[p align="start"]This update doesn’t just add scenes—it deepens the story. It injects American Sunset with raw drama, moral choices, and unflinching erotic tension. It’s unapologetic, unpredictable, and unforgettable.
[p align="start"]The heat is rising—and it’s here.

notes.title: UPDATE RELEASE: 4K + Dominique & Coco
notes.notes:
Today, we're releasing a FREE expansion with new Dominique and Coco content. Furthermore, everything we've done so far has been upscaled to 4K resolution.

MORE ABOUT THE EXPANSION
Justin’s provocative publisher, Dominique, takes the spotlight in this new content arc. What starts as a slow burn — full of subtle tension and romantic charm — quickly turns into a wild emotional rollercoaster. As Dominique lets go of control, she dives deep into a mix of female domination, revenge, and emotional fallout. Expect scenes that are raw, hot, and deeply psychological, pushing boundaries in all the right ways.



In contrast, we’re crafting a tender, introspective storyline with Coco, who slowly begins to reconnect with her bisexual side after a long emotional drought. Experience warm, sensual moments with Coco and your wife, as she rediscovers intimacy, explores her desires, and possibly opens herself to something more… including Justin. Is there more? Absolutely.


4K CONTENT
Alongside the two emotionally charged storylines—each featuring beautifully rendered, desire-filled sex scenes—we’re also introducing a significant visual upgrade. We’re moving from Full HD to stunning 4K resolution, ensuring you won’t miss a single detail. Every inch of our models’ bodies will be more vivid, more lifelike, and more immersive than ever before.

notes.title: Release date + info about UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
I'm delighted that, after what seemed like an eternity, our game has finally been approved! 
The release date is set for January 24th. 

Another good news is, that we plan to add the latest expansion, so the version published on STEAM will already have CALEB RENOVATION AND OFFICE ROMANCE content. Yeah!

UPDATE 1
CALEB BASEMENT RENOVATION AND OFFICE ROMANCE

The first part of the update presents the process of the Renovation of Justin’s basement, during which you’ll meet CALEB, DEREK’S friend. He will not only finish your basement, creating a new interactive space in your house, but also get involved in a hot romance with your wife. After your permission, she will tease him, and finally, the three of you will land in the redecorated basement for an uber-hot threesome scene. When the construction is complete, you’ll be able to invite TRACY and LISA there to spend some wild moments with girls, wearing a super sexy set of clothes.
